name: E2B Sandbox
description: Adds the E2B MCP server preset (code execution in ephemeral Firecracker microVM sandboxes via @e2b/mcp-server), E2B connection settings, a /sandbox status report, and a Sandboxes panel. Workspace provisioning and the microVM execution tier are inactive in this build: the e2b SDK is not bundled.

apiKey.title: E2B / AgentENV API key
apiKey.description: For the E2B workspace backend, which is inactive in this build. Saved keys are moved to the OS keyring, so this field clears after save. The E2B MCP server preset does not read this value: enter its key in the preset's own E2B_API_KEY field under Settings → MCP Servers.

apiUrl.title: AgentENV / E2B API URL
apiUrl.description: Set this to your AgentENV server URL, for example http://127.0.0.1:8000. Leave empty for E2B Cloud.

domain.title: E2B domain override
domain.description: Advanced: the SDK's native domain option (for example a self-hosted E2B domain). Takes precedence over the API URL when set.

browser.reason: Requires npx to spawn @e2b/mcp-server — desktop only.

mobile.reason: Spawns @e2b/mcp-server via npx — unavailable on mobile.

commands.name: /sandbox
commands.description: Show E2B sandbox connection status, live workspaces, and setup steps.

mcpServerPresets.name: E2B Sandbox
mcpServerPresets.description: Run code in ephemeral Firecracker microVM sandboxes — Python, Node, shell, file ops. Untrusted-code safe.

fields.label: E2B / AgentENV API key
fields.description: Required for E2B Cloud; optional for local AgentENV if auth is disabled. Enter it here: the preset does not read the key saved in the E2B Sandbox plugin settings.

fields.label: AgentENV / E2B API URL
fields.description: Set this to your AgentENV server URL. Leave empty for E2B Cloud.
